page.title: Birds of Paradise
page.subtitle: Colors that Soar.
page.heroDescription: Form and function take flight together: inspired by the exuberant plumage and fluid motion of its namesake birds, the design translates organic curves, a deliberately colorful interior, with coordinated radiators, tubing, fittings, coolant, and motherboard accents, into a powerhouse build.

embed.title: Introducing Birds of Paradise, our Intensely Colorful New Masterworks PCs

content.quote: "From spectacular displays of color-shifting neons to shrimp-fueled pinks, there’s no shortage of mind-bending showmanship taking up residence in the sun drenched regions of our planet. Birds of Paradise takes inspiration from these masters of color with neon shades of red, green, pink and blue that can be found in even the smallest details, like the tube fittings, the custom motherboard plating, or the neon mesh peaking through the vents on the chassis. Each variant was carefully designed, and colors meticulously balanced throughout the build so as to never feel overwhelming, but harmonious—even in its fearless use of eye-catching palettes."

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
